_ _  This appeal coming on for admission this day, the court   following:
 ORDER
With the consent of both learned counsel for the parties, heard finally at motion stage.

This appeal has been filed by the claimant/appellant under Section 173 (1) of the Motor Vehicles Act,
1988 against the award dated 17.02.2023 passed in MACC No.150/2015 by 9th Additional M.A.C.T,
Rewa District-Rewa seeking enhancement of compensation.
2. Learned counsel for the appellants submits that Tribunal has wrongly determined appellant's monthly income as Rs.5,000/-., whereas, it should have been determined as Rs.5,939/- per month.
It is also urged that no amount has been awarded for loss of amenities.
Therefore, compensation awarded by the Tribunal be suitably enhanced.
3. Learned counsel for respondent/Insurance Company submits that compensation awarded by the Tribunal is just & proper.
No enhancement is required.

4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
5.
So far as income of appellant is concerned, on the date of accident, minimum wages of an unskilled labour were Rs.5,939/- per month.

In the instant case, Tribunal has determined 20%
permanent disability and multiplier of 17 is to be applied.
Further, appellant is also entitled to receive Rs.1,00,000/- for loss of amenities.

6. In view of above, compensation awarded by Tribunal is recalculated as under:-
S.No. Heads Compensation 1.

Monthly Income of the appellant Prior to Rs.5,939/-
